result.description: A fictional 27-inch ultrawide productivity display designed for cartography, music editing, and split-screen document work. It features a 5120x2160 IPS panel, 98% DCI-P3 coverage, 400 nits typical brightness, and a single-cable USB-C connection with 90W power delivery. The stand supports height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, and the chassis includes a matte anti-glare finish with dual HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 inputs.
